facts.text: I am planning a trip to Japan.
I want a package deal that includes flights, hotel, and guided tours.
I want a room with an ocean view when booking a package with travel agencies.
I am interested in booking a package with All Japan Tours.
I want a quote for a 7-night package.
I want the 7-night package to include flights, hotel, and guided tours.
I want an ocean-view room in Tokyo for the 7-night package.
I want the hotel room to have an ocean view that faces east so I can see the sunrise.
When booking, I want a Tokyo Bay View Room with Balcony or a Premium Ocean View Room that faces east.
I want a room with a great view of the sunrise.

keyphrases: Tokyo Bay View Room with Balcony
